cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Raise the Stakes
cards.instruction: Persuade them to accept a larger risk, cost, or commitment so the outcome will feel decisive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Let's make this chess game decide who cooks all weekend.

beats.text: We were playing for a biscuit.

beats.speaker: A

mechanism: Copy a captured-piece removal with an uncaptured queen, then demand a consequential wager despite the self-created disadvantage.
confusable: Not simply a reckless bettor: B2 must identify the misunderstood removal and A3 must pretend it was a deliberate variant.
comparison: Domestic meal work differs from rival captains' administrative workload.
seedUse: Retains chess biscuit-versus-cooking stakes; adds wrongly copied queen removal and a negotiated restoration.
